# fjordrun_team_billing (Resource)

A team's spending limit and auto-recharge settings. There is one per team and it always exists, so creating this resource takes over the current settings. Needs the admin role.

Plans, payment methods and credit purchases go through the dashboard (browser flows).

Destroying this resource turns auto-recharge off, so an unmanaged card is not charged, and **leaves the spending limit as it is**, so spending doesn't become unlimited by accident.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "team_id" {
  type = string
}

resource "fjordrun_team_billing" "limits" {
  team_id         = var.team_id
  usage_limit_eur = 200

  # Needs a saved payment method: add one in the dashboard first.
  auto_recharge_enabled         = true
  auto_recharge_threshold_eur   = 5
  auto_recharge_amount_eur      = 20
  auto_recharge_monthly_cap_eur = 100
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `team_id` (String) Team ID.

### Optional

- `auto_recharge_amount_eur` (Number) How many EUR to add per recharge (10 to 500).
- `auto_recharge_enabled` (Boolean) Charge the saved payment method when credit runs low. Enabling it fails until the team has a saved payment method.
- `auto_recharge_monthly_cap_eur` (Number) Most EUR to charge per calendar month (10 to 5000, at least the recharge amount).
- `auto_recharge_threshold_eur` (Number) Recharge when credit falls below this many EUR (1 to 1000).
- `usage_limit_eur` (Number) Monthly spending limit in EUR (0 to 1000000, two decimals). **Leaving it out means no limit**: this resource manages the limit, and removes one set elsewhere.

### Read-Only

- `current_period_end` (String) End of the current billing period, if the team has a subscription.
- `has_payment_method` (Boolean) Whether a payment method is saved.
- `id` (String) The team ID.
- `plan` (String) The team's plan.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# by team ID
terraform import fjordrun_team_billing.limits 11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111
```
